MIT, Copyright (c) 2017 Brady Holt

GifOS inlines classic scripts. This is the English-only UMD (not the i18n
bundle). Type a cron expression, read it in English. Last expression is
saved privately. Press Invite to show the same translation, read-only, in a
meeting. Upstream is a library with a demo page; this directory is the wrap.
Nothing is fetched.
